question: Should OpenClaw adopt durable memory role slots such as `memory.recall`, `memory.capture`, `memory.compaction`, `memory.dreaming`, and `memory.userModel`, or keep memory as a single active slot and solve coexistence through narrower plugin APIs?
rationale: The request changes public config, plugin activation, per-agent semantics, doctor migration, and docs, while VISION.md both welcomes plugin API extensions and currently describes memory as one special active slot.

options.title: Sponsor role-slot implementation
options.body: Review and land or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 with an approved taxonomy, migration plan, docs, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Stage narrower memory APIs
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for smaller protocols such as dreaming or user-model hooks before committing to the full slot taxonomy.

options.title: Defer to single-slot memory
options.body: Close or deprioritize this direction if maintainers decide memory should converge on one recommended slot with companion plugins outside that selector.

recommendation.title: Sponsor role-slot implementation
recommendation.body: Review and land or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 with an approved taxonomy, migration plan, docs, and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete introduced the memory slot surface and is the clearest history-backed owner for the product/API direction question among the routed people.
